description: Council Lv6+ ≥ 3 multisig attestation that a silicon design / lot / equipment commit has been reviewed against Charter Rider §2(a) (weapons) + §2(c) (mass surveillance). Per ADR-2605242500 §Decision 4 + ADR-2605242545 §Decision 4. REQUIRED for every commit under 50-infra/silicon/equipment/ion-implant/ and equipment/lithography/ (HIGH risk), plus any chipManufacturingAttestation issuance.

scopeUri.description: Git commit SHA URL, lot-id, or AT URI being reviewed.

riskClass.description: Charter Rider §2(a) (weapons) and/or §2(c) (mass surveillance) risk classification.

designIntentNarrative.description: Human-authored narrative explaining the intended use, expected misuse vectors, and mitigations. Required per ADR-2605242500 §Decision 4 §1 (set-time review).

councilAttestors.description: DIDs of Council Lv6+ members who attested. Must be ≥ 3 per ADR-2605242500 §Decision 4 §2.

verdictConditions.description: If verdict = approve-with-conditions, the conditions list. Otherwise empty.

objectionPeriodEndsAt.description: If verdict = defer-30day-objection, the end of the public objection window per ADR-2605192300.

supersedesUri.description: If this review revises a prior one, point to it.
